visualReview.method: Opened the saved screenshots with view_image and inspected actual model pixels, expression differences, overlays and complete phone framing.

screenshots.result: Real Cubism2 model visible with clear hair, skin and uniform; smiling face.
After 700ms expression blend, brows/eyes/mouth and folded-arm pose visibly differ from happy. Not inferred solely from data attributes.
Face and upper body visible; mode/map controls do not cover the face; composer and rescue control separate.
Final compact crop visibly enlarged to upper body. Eyes, brows and mouth are readable; mode/map controls remain separate from face. Composer and rescue control do not overlap.
Campus sandtable and six facility pins visible; removed 2D campus option absent.
Campus sandtable and six facility pins visible; scrolling controls verified in the dedicated gesture case.
Complete proportionally scaled embedded phone visible without former green outer panel; phone draft retained and surrounding controls accessible.

checks: Novel mode unmounts the outdoor/interior 3D scene and changes the location background.
Mode switching retains story, input draft, saved state and 3D expanded-story reading position; novel preference and location recover after reload.
AVG advances one segment per click, keeps the last reading segment through mode switching and full-text viewing, and preserves phone JSON protocol.
Novel travel matches existing fare/transit quote; failed persistence rolls back location and background.
Real embedded phone preserves the same iframe, its draft and original novel sentence across scale changes and reopening.
Campus sandtable blends continuously into city view, supports touch zoom/rotate/recenter, and does not travel on a map drag.
